tools.name: end_turn
tools.description: End this turn: nothing more you want to say or do right now. New events will wake you again. This is the normal way to finish a turn.

summary.zh: 结束这一轮,等新事件再醒。
summary.en: Ends the turn until a new event arrives.

form.en: Not implemented yet. v0.1 only reserves memoryDir and blobs/ as mount points; the session log is the only persistence.
